en.t: The water was still there, not a drop missing.

units.source_text: 他又一口气喝了三四口，再一次惊叹那透明矿物质的滋味，到底掩藏不住涌上心头的不安。

en.t: He gulped down three or four more mouthfuls, once again marveling at the taste of that clear mineral substance, but in the end he could not hide the uneasiness rising in his chest.

units.source_text: 大概就这样到傍晚也不会再拿水来了吧。

en.t: Most likely, at this rate, they would not bring any more water until evening.
Needless to say, cooking a meal would be impossible too.

units.source_text: 那些家伙一步步都算计好了的。

en.t: Those people had calculated every step of it.

units.source_text: 他们打算把干渴的恐怖当做缰绳，来威逼我就范呐。

en.t: They intended to use the terror of thirst as a bridle, to force me into submission.
